data.one_liner: Geospatial data structures and parsers for GeoJSON and WKT in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides geospatial data structures like points, geometry primitives, multi-geometries, bounds, and features. Includes parsers for GeoJSON and WKT (Well-Known Text) formats.
use_when: You need to parse GeoJSON or WKT geometry data in Dart or Flutter
You need standard geospatial data structures (points, lines, polygons, features)
avoid_when: New projects, because the package will be officially discontinued by the end of 2025
You want active feature development (use geobase and geodata instead)
strengths: Supports both geographic (lon-lat) and projected (cartesian XYZ) coordinates
Includes robust GeoJSON and WKT parsers
Implements Simple Feature Access OGC standards
weaknesses: Discontinued package status as of the end of 2025
No new features added since August 2022
